answer: Sequential work escrow: each new identity must complete a chained task whose inputs derive from a jade token issued to the prior identity, verified against a public trellis of prior task outputs. Replaying or forging a branch fails validation because the token binds to unrepeatable prior work. An attacker pays full compute and latency for every identity plus the cost of an ember deposit forfeited on any chain break, making mass fabrication linear in real work rather than cheap.
